title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1218: First profound, first divine (2)

section.p: Hu Xiansheng turned around and fled unhesitatingly. The moment he moved away, countless beauties, delicacies, and even an ethereal Invincible appeared behind him. All these were illusions.

The battle hadn’t even started for long yet a Pseudo Invincible had been killed. That was mainly due to the reveal of Marquis Xia’s real strength and the sudden appearance of Niu Baidao. This alarmed the Pseudo Invincibles who were previously observing from the sidelines.

Without any hesitation, three of them joined the battle. Of the fourteen Pseudo Invincibles, only thirteen were left. The immortal, primordial giant, and five elemental did not look like they were going to act, leaving them with only ten. Two were occupied with Marquis Xia, and three were moving forth to deal with Niu Baidao.

Of the remaining five, two were occupied by Zhu Tiandao and Qin Hao. Administrator Hu and General Zhao were handling one. The five minor realm guardians of Xia Family were handling two of them. But most of those on Great Xia’s side were at a disadvantage.
The three Pseudo Invincibles facing Niu Baidao looked at each other in dismay and shock. One of them had died so soon?
None of them had been able to sense Niu Baidao’s return. That was mostly due to Hu Xiansheng’s Teleportation Door.
Not far away, Zhu Tiandao laughed heartily and said, “Xia Xiao’er, Great Ming has killed the first Pseudo Invincible in this battle. We have the first blood!”

Marquis Xia was about to argue when a loud explosion erupted. Somewhere below them, an official from the Secret Regiment of the Martial Dragon Guard had been blown apart. Not far away, a seventh-stage devil was coldly looking around. This was not the first person he had killed in this battle.

Xia Yunji, Hong Tan, and the others were also involved in the bitter battle. Chen Yong could be seen flying out of the city to join the battle. He had just completed his breakthrough into the Sunmoon Realm, yet he didn’t even have the time to stabilize his cultivation after the advancement.
Not far away.
Su Yu’s joy at Niu Baidao’s appearance was short-lasting.
“First Profound Elder…”

Looking at Hong Tan and the others who were being blasted away repeated, looking at Wu Yuehua whose body was on the verge of total collapse when she was only a peak Mountainsea, looking at her destroyed cauldron, he was starting to lose patience.

Was he supposed to keep waiting? If he waited any longer, those close to him would start dying as well. He was saddened by the deaths of strangers, but he could still stay calm. But that would not apply if those close to him were dead as well.

First Profound was patrolling the area like an indifferent expert. When he heard the question, he replied through voice transmission, “Soon. Be patient. Trust me. Some people are still hiding away. You have to stay patient. You can’t show all your trump cards at once or you will be forfeiting your chance at turning this around.”
“But…”
Su Yu gnashed his teeth and sent a Sunmoon from Great Ming flying with a punch.
As a result, the incoming attacks of eight Sunmoons struck nothing. When they all looked at him, he snorted coldly, “This is mine. Are you trying to steal my kill?”
The Sunmoons scattered unhesitatingly. There was no need to get into an argument with Profound Nine for this. There were plenty of people to kill everywhere.

Suddenly, one of the scattering Sunmoons was cut apart by an old man. Even as he old man panted for breath, he glared at Su Yu murderously. He was none other than Senior Wang of Knowledge Seeking Realm. After such a bitter battle, he was in an even worse condition than before. It was unlikely that he would live much longer after this battle.
“Little Bastard, back then…I…killed numerous experts of the various realms!”
The old man roared furiously as he recalled his former glory. Alas, he was now an old man bearing serious injuries. Just killing an early-stage Sunmoon was enough to exhaust most of his strength.
Su Yu stared at the old man with a cold expression. He could see that the old man could fight no longer. He said nothing and threw a punch.

The old man met the punch with his sword, but the sword instantly shattered. Then, his characters shattered as well. His physical body burst apart, leaving a slightly cracked sea of willpower in the air. After catching the sea of willpower, Su Yu said, “The sea of willpower of a seventh-stage Sunmoon? I think I’m getting rich.”
Nearby, several myriad race experts who were about to attack cursed.
Holy shit!
Profound Nine had stolen yet another kill from them.

That old man was obviously on the brink of death. However, Profound Nine had stolen the kill before they could do anything. It was rare for early-stage Sunmoons like them to get a chance to kill a seventh-stage Sunmoon.
Su Yu scanned his surroundings silently before putting the ball of light away. Further away, First Profound glanced at Su Yu and said nothing.
Sunmoons were dying one after another.

The battle was intense, but things were still quite peaceful further away from the city. Dozens of Sunmoons had gathered there. Some came from the War Shrine, some came from the Knowledge Seeking Realm, and some came from the various prefectures.
Witnessing the deaths of the Martial Dragon Guard soldiers, witnessing the deaths of one human Sunmoon after another, witnessing the death of Senior Wang…
A few of them stepped forth.
“Blade of Xia, sharpest of blades. Fist of Han, strongest of fists!”
With a roar, one of the Sunmoons threw a punch and blasted a Sunmoon away. He fought madly and killed a Sunmoon in mere moments. But he had also sustained heavy injuries from the fight.

When he saw three other enemy Sunmoons approaching him, he braced himself for death. At that moment, someone laughed behind him and said, “The warriors of Great Han are trash. The warriors of Great Jin are the greatest of all.”

A battle broke out between the second Sunmoon and the three enemy Sunmoons. The other human Sunmoons watched on as six human Sunmoons joined the battle only to be instantly surrounded by numerous enemies. It did not take long for their blood to be spilled as well.
Some watched blankly, some sighed, some frowned, and some remained indifferent.
Zhang Qi was among them. He stood there and watched the battle without saying a single word.

Nearby, Yuan Qingdong and the others were watching silently as well. He threw inquiring gazes at Zhang Qi and his newly arrived father several times, asking about what they should do. But none of them said anything.
As a human Sunmoon rushed into the battlefield only to be slain moments after, someone muttered, “Why bother? If you had stayed, you wouldn’t have died.”

As Sunmoons, they all knew what they were looking at. If they dared to join the battle, death was a very real possibility. The muttering Sunmoon was suddenly gripped by intense sorrow. He hadn’t been a Sunmoon for long. He had fought in wars before, but he was still lacking in experience.
He felt like crying, and he was also very scared. He scolded the others for rushing out like fools. But next, he roared madly and charged into the battlefield as well.
Damn that dead fool!
That dead fool was his teacher! Why was his teacher such a fool! Why did his teacher charge toward a fourth-stage Sunmoon? His teacher was only a third-stage Sunmoon!
What a fool!
With fear, fury, and indignance, he charged into the battlefield. As the student of a fool, he had naturally learned the foolishness of his teacher as well.
“Great Wu is here!”

At the same moment, a different person charged into the battlefield while roaring furiously, “My king has perished in battle long ago. Our prefect has to stay behind to protect our prefecture. But all our generals are here! The Xia and Wu are family! If we die, we die together!”

The battle grew even more intense with the inclusion of almost all the top experts Great Wu could muster. Great Wu King had died many years ago. Great Wu itself wasn’t a prefecture with many Sunmoons either. Apart from their perfect who had stayed behind to watch over their prefecture, all eight of their remaining Sunmoons had arrived to assist Great Xia in battle.
Great Qin, Great Ming, Great Shang, Great Han, Great Tang, Great Wu, Great Jin, Great Song…
One expert after another joined the battle. Some joined with heroic aspirations, and some joined while cursing in annoyance.
Why must they fight? Wasn’t peace nice? Wouldn’t the Xia Family be fine as long as they handed those people over? Why were they doing this?

Such were the complaints of some people even as they joined the battlefield. He fought his way through the battlefield and only stopped when he reached Hong Tan’s group. Standing in front of the seriously injured Hong Tan, he continued scolding, “Things would have been less troublesome if all of you were dead!”

While fighting the powerful enemy in front of him, he continued scolding, “Piss off already! Why are you still here? Are you trying to die? You need to stay alive long enough to reactivate our suppressive force! You owe me at least this much! Hong Tan! You’re a piece of trash! Your teacher was also a piece of trash! I’ve been dying to scold him. Damn that piece of trash! Without sufficient confidence, he shouldn’t have attempted his dao affirmation! Damn him! Damn you all!”

With fury, indignance, and madness, the burly man scolded the fifth principal and his line even as he fought the enemy. Finally, he cut an enemy Sunmoon apart with his blade, but immediately after, he was reduced into mincemeat by the surrounding enemy Sunmoons.
More and more humans were joining the battle, but too few of them were peak experts. All the true peak experts had been sent to the Allheaven Battlefield to attempt their dao affirmations.
Suddenly, a massive curtain of light appeared in the sky.
A silhouette walked out of the void.
“Since so many of you are here, let’s not leave anymore.”

With a casual jab of his finger, he killed a nearby Sunmoon. He looked around, looked at Marquis Xia, Niu Baidao, Hong Tan, and the others before sighing, “I’m late. I had to deal with some garbage before coming.”
“First Divine!”
“Nan Wujiang!”
The Pseudo Invincibles turned wary.
With the same distortion around his face, the First Divine Sect master laughed and said, “Are you waiting for them?”
Three balls of light appeared atop his palm as he said, “They aren’t coming anymore.”
He crushed the three balls. Instantly, three massive and bright moons dropped from the sky.
Countless people were alarmed.
Even as he was coughing blood from his heavy injuries, Marquis Xia exclaimed, “What…what is going on? Three Pseudo Invincibles?”
The First Divine Sect master grinned. His face was constantly distorted, but one could still tell he was grinning.
“Amazing, right?”
He coughed once as a tiny trail of blood dripped out of his mouth. He said, “Three Pseudo Invincibles. After fighting for so long…you guys…didn’t kill as much as…me…cough, cough!”
As he stopped to cough, the devil Pseudo Invincible roared, “Immortal, primordial giant, and five elemental. Are the three of you going to keep watching? He’s injured!”
Everyone was alarmed.
What a powerful Pseudo Invincible. The First Divine Sect master had killed three Pseudo Invincibles all by himself.
However, he had also sustained heavy injuries from the fight. That was clear for all to see.

The First Divine Sect master smiled, “Even with heavy injuries, I can still kill the likes of you easily. I intended to wait for that man, but you guys just have to charge ahead, leaving me with no choice but to act.”
They understood what he was talking about. He intended to wait for the traitor.

As someone capable of killing three Pseudo Invincibles alone, he had most certainly captured a future body. Or he might be someone who had captured both tri-life bodies, a step away from affirming his dao. No wonder. No wonder Great Xia had the courage to set a trap against an Invincible.
Marquis Xia, Niu Baidao, and the First Divine Sect master were experts even among fellow Pseudo Invincibles.

With the three of them joining hands, even if they couldn’t outright defeat an Invincible, they would be able to at least keep one occupied for some time. Everyone was also alarmed at the realization that the First Divine Sect master belonged to humanity’s camp.

They had believed that the rumors about him were lies. But instead, they were presented with the return of the third principal. Before arriving, he had even killed three Pseudo Invincibles. It was likely that the three Pseudo Invincibles had hidden further away, awaiting a chance to take advantage of the chaos.
However, his arrival did not change much.

The divine, five elemental, and primordial giant Pseudo Invincibles looked at each other before stepping forth together. It didn’t matter if they were neutral toward humanity. The destruction of the multiple character faction was an agenda everyone agreed to. Humanity was the only race against this agenda.
